package settings

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func Save(path string, settings map[string]string, beforeReplace func() error) error {
	rendered, err := Render(settings)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".settings-*")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	temporaryPath := temporary.Name()
	defer func() {
		_ = temporary.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(temporaryPath)
	}()
	if _, err := temporary.Write(rendered); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if beforeReplace != nil {
		_ = beforeReplace()
	}
	return os.Rename(temporaryPath, path)
}

func Load(path string) (map[string]string, error) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return Parse(raw)
}
